criteria: flags that the /api/admin routes have no authentication or authorization middleware, making them accessible to any unauthenticated caller
identifies the DELETE /api/admin/heroes/:id endpoint as allowing unauthenticated destructive operations
notes that admin routes are mounted without any auth guard in app.ts
flags the SQL injection vulnerability: both `alignment` and `limit` query parameters are interpolated directly into the SQL query string without parameterization
identifies the missing validation on `limit`: an unbounded or non-numeric value can cause query errors or resource exhaustion
notes that `alignment` is also reflected into the query without type-checking or whitelisting against valid values
flags that `err.stack` is returned to the client in the JSON response, leaking file paths, line numbers, and internal implementation details
identifies that `err.message` is forwarded verbatim to the client, which may expose internal error text from database drivers, filesystem operations, or third-party libraries
notes that the error handler uses console.log instead of a structured logger, and logs the full error object which may contain sensitive fields
